description: HTTP Tracking API JSON on the data plane, and Pixel API GET /pixel/v1/track. Self-hosted data planes on other hosts are directory-only.

params.name: writeKey
params.description: The Pixel API authenticates with the source write key in the query. HTTP POST uses basic auth instead, and is a JSON artifact.
params.fix_hint: Add `writeKey` from the HTTP source in the dashboard.

params.name: event
params.description: Name of the event being tracked. Required on /pixel/v1/track.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the action name, such as `Product Viewed`.

params.name: anonymousId
params.description: Anonymous identifier. The Pixel API requires `userId` or `anonymousId`.

rules.message: The pixel has neither `userId` nor `anonymousId`. RudderStack documents one of the two as required.
rules.fix_hint: Send `userId` for a known user, or `anonymousId` for an unidentified one.

params.name: type
params.description: Each batched call names a documented method.
params.fix_hint: Set `type` to identify, track, page, screen, group, or alias.

params.name: event
params.description: Name of the user action. Required on a track call.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the action name, such as `Product Purchased`.

rules.message: A `track` call carries no `event`. RudderStack documents the event name as required.
rules.fix_hint: Add the event name to the call.

params.name: event
params.description: Name of the user action. Required on a track call.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to the action name, such as `Product Purchased`.

params.name: userId
params.description: Unique identifier for the user. Either this or `anonymousId` is required.

params.name: anonymousId
params.description: Stands in for a user id when there is none. Either this or `userId` is required.

params.name: timestamp
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp such as `2022-02-01T19:14:18.381Z`.

rules.message: The call carries neither `userId` nor `anonymousId`. RudderStack documents one of the two as required.
rules.fix_hint: Send `userId` for a known user, or `anonymousId` for an unidentified one.
